_meta.description: Backtested winning strategy per market. Every number traces to a point-in-time backtest in the global-market-research-platform. Research only — NOT investment advice.
_meta.method: PIT backtests; Deflated-Sharpe multiple-testing correction; non-overlapping t-stats; sufficiency-gated (only markets with enough powered+complete data get a verdict).
_meta.universal_finding: Momentum/trend (bull regime) is the ONE metric that works in nearly every market and survives multiple-testing (IN trend, KR breakout, EU mom252). Mean-reversion works only in bear regimes and is FRAGILE everywhere (fails Deflated Sharpe). Value-reversion works where the data is powered (IN, US, KR).

screen.long: trend up AND cheap-vs-sector AND ROE>15%

backtest_earnings.trend_factor: IR 2.34 over 331 weeks; Deflated Sharpe 0.994 — SURVIVES 0.95 (the single most robust factor found)
backtest_earnings.value_reversion: sector-relative cheap−rich = +5.3% / 6M, t 2.5 (≈ +10.9%/yr spread); multiples converge to sector median
backtest_earnings.shorting: value+quality L/S = −1.00% / 6M, t −0.71 — FAILS; momentum runs the short leg over → never short India

IN.sufficiency: powered (17 non-overlap obs, 2012–2026) — coverage 50% of liquid universe (returns reliable; watch coverage bias)

backtest_earnings.reversion: cheap−rich = +1.72% / 3M, t 2.32 (≈ +6.9%/yr); FADES to +3.18%/6M t1.16 → use ≤3M horizon
backtest_earnings.momentum: mom252 IR 1.19, Deflated Sharpe 0.901 — does NOT survive 0.95 (fragile); F-score is INVERTED in the US

US.sufficiency: powered (17 obs, 1987–2026, 64% coverage) — TRUST short-horizon reversion
US.verdict: TRUST short-horizon value reversion (≤3M), light sizing. Don't lean on US momentum.

screen.long: cheap (low PE vs peers) AND high ROE

backtest_earnings.value_quality_ls: +4.83% / 6M, t 4.17 (≈ +9.9%/yr) — the STRONGEST edge found in any market (193/204 obs)
backtest_earnings.breakout: IR 2.04 over 227 weeks, Deflated Sharpe 0.99 — SURVIVES 0.95

KR.sufficiency: powered (17 obs via DART, 96% raw / 58% liquid coverage)
KR.verdict: TRUST — full long/short: long cheap∩hi-ROE, short expensive∩lo-ROE.

backtest_earnings.momentum: mom252 IR 1.39 over 375 weeks, Deflated Sharpe 0.985 — SURVIVES 0.95 (bull regime)
backtest_earnings.value: INSUFFICIENT DATA — 5y, ~9 non-overlap obs → underpowered; the headline +36% reversion was a data artifact, not an effect

EU.sufficiency: UNDERPOWERED for value (9 obs); momentum factor is robust
EU.verdict: Momentum only (bull). Value cannot be concluded until deeper history.

JP.character: value-reversion — STRONG (revealed by deep EDINET data)
JP.book: long cheap-vs-market (full L/S viable — ROE available)

backtest_earnings.value_reversion: TESTED, POWERED on deep EDINET data (Sakana EDINET-Bench, 1,437 tickers, 2011–2024, 116 monthly formations, ~17–19 non-overlap obs): cheap−rich = +3.05%/3M (t 5.30), +6.60%/6M (t 4.84) — one of the STRONGEST value edges across all markets. Multiples converge (rich 4.72→4.50×, cheap 0.33→0.34× toward median).
backtest_earnings.technical_factors: no factor survives Deflated Sharpe (golden_cross 0.857, revert 0.105) — no robust technical edge; the edge is fundamental (value).
backtest_earnings.flip_note: This FLIPS the earlier 'underpowered / can't conclude'. That verdict was a pure data-DEPTH artifact (J-Quants free ~2y). Deep EDINET history (no API key — via the EDINET-Bench parquets) reveals Japan as a strong value-reversion market.

JP.sufficiency: POWERED (2011–2024, 17 non-overlap obs) via EDINET-Bench. Coverage 36% (THIN) and the EDINET-Bench panel is a task-sample (earnings/fraud) not the full universe, so magnitude may be biased — but t 4.84 is decisive on direction + significance. Re-run on the full corpus if an EDINET API key lands.
JP.verdict: REAL VERDICT (flipped): value-reversion WORKS strongly in Japan (+6.6%/6M, t 4.84). Long cheap-vs-market; short the richest for a full L/S. The last 'insufficient' is now a tested edge.

CN.character: momentum / retail-driven — value does NOT mean-revert into returns
CN.book: no value edge (momentum likely dominates, untested)

screen.long: NOT value — cheap ≠ higher return in China

backtest_earnings.value_reversion: TESTED, POWERED (10y akshare 2015–2025, 426 tickers, 109 monthly formations, ~17 non-overlap 6M obs): cheap−rich = −0.31%/3M (t 0.04), +0.45%/6M (t −0.18) — NO return spread.
backtest_earnings.convergence: The PE multiple DOES converge (rich 3.77→3.09×, cheap 0.34→0.37× toward median) — but prices don't reward it, so value is not tradeable.
backtest_earnings.interpretation: A REAL NULL result (powered), not insufficient data: China's momentum/retail character compresses multiples without paying a value return premium.

CN.sufficiency: POWERED (10y depth, 17 non-overlap obs) but coverage THIN (426 of ~3,454 liquid) — returns reliable, watch coverage bias; collection continues.
CN.verdict: REAL VERDICT: value-reversion FAILS in China (powered null). Do NOT run a value screen here; momentum likely dominates (not yet tested).

sizing_discipline: Inverse-vol + vol-target + kill-switch. Capacity ~$300–500k before the illiquidity edge decays (dead by $10M). All earnings are GROSS of costs (Almgren-Chriss impact) and short-borrow; net edge must clear those. The real edge is illiquidity, not size.
